# runpod_gpu_types (Data Source)

GPU types available for pod creation, from the catalog API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_gpu_types" "all" {}

output "gpu_ids" {
  description = "GPU type identifiers, usable as runpod_pod.gpu_type_id."
  value       = [for g in data.runpod_gpu_types.all.gpu_types : g.id]
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
use-case modules under `v2/modules/` in the provider repository; the Guides
section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `gpu_types` (Attributes List) All GPU types with their specs, pricing, and data-center availability. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gpu_types))

<a id="nestedatt--gpu_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gpu_types`

Read-Only:

- `community` (Boolean) Available on community cloud.
- `id` (String) GPU type identifier, e.g. "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090".
- `memory` (Number) VRAM in GB.
- `name` (String) Human-readable GPU name.
- `pool` (String) Serverless GPU pool ID for runpod_serverless_endpoint.gpu_pools; null when not in a pool.
- `price_community` (Number) Community cloud price in USD/hr.
- `price_secure` (Number) Secure cloud price in USD/hr.
- `secure` (Boolean) Available on secure cloud.
